Class IdentitiesController

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.admin.IdentitiesController
@RestController public class IdentitiesController extends Object
who's identity admin endpoints:
  • GET /identities?status=&role=&email=&page=0&size=20 pages through identities, oldest first, as an IdentityPage. status is an IdentityStatus name; role a role's name, which an unknown role matches no identity by; email an address, matched as email sign-in matches it, which finds at most one identity and is 400 without email sign-in. Given together, every filter must match. size runs from 1 to 100;
  • GET /identities/{id} answers one IdentityView;
  • PATCH /identities/{id} with {"status": "ACTIVE"} reactivates the identity and with {"status": "DISABLED"} deactivates it, as WhoService does, and answers its IdentityView; any other status, SUSPENDED included, is 400. The caller cannot deactivate itself: 409;
  • PUT and DELETE /identities/{id}/roles/{role} assign and remove a role, 204 whether or not anything changed. The caller may assign only a role whose every permission it holds itself, or it is 403 (see RoleGrants); removing is not restricted by the role's permissions.

Any who sign-in may call them: a browser session, a bearer token, or an API key. The GETs need WhoAdminPermissions.IDENTITIES_READ, the rest WhoAdminPermissions.IDENTITIES_MANAGE, among the request's permissions (for an API key, those its scopes keep); without it, 403. A browser session (a who session cookie with no API key or bearer token beside it) that changes anything must have signed in recently, or it is 401 and must sign in again; a bearer token or an API key need not. These are checked in that order, signed out (401) first, by AdminGate, before any identity, role or body is looked at. Then an unknown identity, an id that is not a UUID and an unknown role are 404. A change to an identity other than the caller's own that holds a permission the caller does not, as who resolves its permissions whatever its status, is 403 IdentityOutranksCallerException, checked before the role-grant rule and before the body. A deactivation or role removal that would leave no active identity holding WhoAdminPermissions.IDENTITIES_MANAGE is 409 LastAdminException (see LastAdminGuard). A query or body who refuses is 400.

    • IdentitiesController

      public IdentitiesController(IdentityRepository identities, WhoService whoService, RbacService rbac, @Nullable IdentityEmails emails, @Nullable LastCredentialGuard guard, LastAdminGuard lastAdmin, AdminGate gate, tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper jsonMapper)
      Creates the controller.
      Parameters:
      identities - pages through and reads identities
      whoService - deactivates and reactivates identities, and resolves their permissions
      rbac - reads, assigns and removes roles
      emails - the identities' addresses; null without email sign-in
      guard - counts each identity's sign-in credentials; null shows no counts
      lastAdmin - keeps the last identity that may manage identities
      gate - admits the caller
      jsonMapper - reads request bodies
